verdict.rationale: xAI documents automatic prompt caching: consecutive requests that share the same starting messages are cached. The pricing page lists a separate cached-input rate per model (grok-4.7: $0.50 vs $2.00 per 1M input tokens), and per-request `cost_in_usd_ticks` reflects the actual amount billed after discounts. Missing for 10: any documented latency benefit, cache mechanics such as TTL, minimum prefix length and cache-hit reporting, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the savings.
